headline: Eaton (ETN) Finance Reshuffle Meets AI Power Narrative With Fair Value In Focus
summary: Eaton (NYSE:ETN) has reshuffled its finance leadership, with long serving controller Adam Wadecki moving into a senior finance role in the Electrical segment and Andrea Trabacchin taking over as principal accounting officer.
